text.I couldn't read “{time}” as a time. Use: I couldn't read “{time}” as a time. Use HH:MM, 9am, noon, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
text.I don't know where “{place}” is. Try a b: I don't know where “{place}” is. Try a big city nearby, a country with one time zone, or an IANA zone like Europe/Paris.
text.{time} doesn't happen on that day: the c: {time} doesn't happen on that day: the clocks skip that hour. Try an hour later.
text.“{time}” isn't a time on a 12-hour clock: “{time}” isn't a time on a 12-hour clock.
